label: C. gariepinus hatchery (226 samples)
description: The MS_Inversions manuscript cohort — 226 pure C. gariepinus hatchery samples sequenced on the LANTA cluster. K=broodline. All per-sample inferences (karyotype calls, Mendelian QC, popstats, HPP burden) are scoped to this cohort.

label: F1 hybrid assembly (Cgar × Cmac)
description: Single F1 hybrid individual sequenced to produce the haplotype-resolved reference assembly (28 LGs from Gar haplotype × 27 LGs from Mac haplotype). Separate paper; the only role this cohort plays in MS_Inversions is providing the coordinate frame.

label: C. macrocephalus wild (future)
description: Future paper on pure C. macrocephalus wild samples. No samples sequenced yet; placeholder so cross-references resolve.

label: Comparative — 18 catfish genomes
description: The full 18-species comparative cohort used for gene-order breakpoint walks (BUSCO synteny18 + synteny5). Strictly coordinate-providing: hands genome coordinates to inversion_atlas; never makes claims about hatchery samples. Spans the full catfish phylogeny — wfmash sequence alignment only covers a sub-cohort (Clariidae @ p90 / Cranoglanis @ p85).

label: Comparative — 5-haplotype Cgar / Cmac (BP_ATLAS)
description: Sub-cohort of comparative_18sp restricted to the 5 Cgar/Cmac haplotypes where the BP_ATLAS pipeline (STEP_BP1..BP6) has actually run end-to-end. BP3c reciprocity (both-anchor validation) is only computed here — it requires sequence alignment which works at p90 within Clariidae but not across the full 18-species set. parent_cohort: comparative_18sp formalises the sub-cohort relationship the audit flagged as 'MIXED'.
